hero.title: One platform for every part of the school day.
hero.subtitle: Scholify connects parents, teachers, supervisors, drivers, and administrators in real time — attendance, grades, bus GPS, homework, chat, and more.

features.title: Everything a school actually runs on.
features.subtitle: Purpose-built for the daily reality of schools — not a generic CRM with a school skin.

attendance.title: Attendance & reports
attendance.desc: Daily roll, weekly summaries, student reports, and full history — all synced across roles.

grades.title: Grades your way
grades.desc: Admin-defined mark types. Each school configures quizzes, exams, and daily marks to match their curriculum.

bus.title: Live bus GPS
bus.desc: Drivers share location every 30 seconds. Parents get proximity alerts at 10, 5, 2 minutes, and on arrival.

chat.title: Parent–teacher chat
chat.desc: Direct messaging between parents and teachers with typing indicators and real-time delivery.

homework.title: Homework & assignments
homework.desc: Post, attach files, and track submissions. Parents see what's due tonight, not what was due yesterday.

academic.title: Academic portal
academic.desc: A separate space for rich posts and ebooks. Teachers publish, families read, everything searchable.

portals.title: Six portals, one source of truth.
portals.subtitle: Each role sees only what they need — and everything they need.

parent.title: Parents
parent.desc: Live bus tracking, attendance, grades, homework, and chat with teachers.

teacher.title: Teachers
teacher.desc: Attendance, grading, homework, weekly summaries, and reports.

supervisor.title: Supervisors
supervisor.desc: Attendance oversight, student reports, weekly reviews.

driver.title: Drivers
driver.desc: Route, student list, start/stop trip, automatic location sharing.

admin.title: Admins
admin.desc: Schools, classes, users, features, announcements — all from one panel.

mobile.title: Mobile app for parents, teachers, supervisors, and drivers.
mobile.subtitle: Same data, same real-time updates — in your pocket. Dark mode, three languages, full RTL.

cta.title: Ready to see Scholify in your school?
cta.subtitle: Request a demo and we'll set up a personalized walkthrough for your team.
